faqs.question: Is the free read a real audit?
faqs.answer: No. It inspects the URL you type — HTTPS, hostname shape, path depth, tracking parameters — and never fetches the page. The full audit runs server-side.

faqs.question: Does Google Growth guarantee AI citations?
faqs.answer: No. It measures readiness: crawler access, llms.txt, structured data, citability and discovery endpoints. It never queries ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.

faqs.question: Is Google Growth open source?
faqs.answer: Yes, under Apache-2.0. The GEO rubric is adapted from the MIT-licensed geo-optimizer-skill model, credited in the docs.
